events.title: Global Cholera Outbreak Surge
events.summary: WHO (30 Jun 2026): 114,829 cases and 1,318 deaths globally since Jan 2026; 43% monthly increase in May.

events.title: Bundibugyo virus outbreak in DRC and Uganda
events.summary: UKHSA (2 Jul 2026): WHO declares PHEIC; 1,333 cases, 399 deaths in DRC; 20 cases in Uganda.

events.title: Measles Resurgence in Americas Region
events.summary: PAHO/WHO (29 May 2026): 20,521 confirmed measles cases in Americas (Jan-May 2026), a fourfold increase from 2025, with 25 deaths.

events.title: Suriname Chikungunya Outbreak Surge
events.summary: IFRC (19 Mar 2026): Suriname confirms 1,357 Chikungunya cases and 1 death since late January outbreak declaration.

events.title: Nigeria Cholera Explosion
events.summary: WHO (30 Jun 2026): Nigeria reports 15,158% case increase in May 2026, driven by Borno State outbreak.

events.title: Afghanistan AWD Crisis
events.summary: WHO (30 Jun 2026): Afghanistan reports 13,645 AWD cases in May 2026, highest in Eastern Mediterranean Region.

events.title: Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever surge in Iraq
events.summary: UKHSA (2 Jul 2026): IFRC reports 171 cases, 11 deaths in Iraq; seasonal surge driven by livestock movement.

events.title: Sri Lanka Dengue Outbreak Surge
events.summary: NDCU (24 Jun 2026): Cases surged to ~37,000 with 30% YoY increase driven by monsoon rains.

events.title: Diphtheria outbreak in Haiti
events.summary: CDC (25 Jun 2026): Reports active diphtheria outbreak in Haiti with high fatality risk; Level 2 travel notice issued.

events.title: Yellow Fever Outbreaks in Africa and Americas
events.summary: WHO DON (24 Jun 2026): 95 human cases reported across 9 countries in Africa and Americas since Jan 2026, with active sylvatic circulation.
